create_point_mass_env: create a PointMass environment with default configuration for simulating a point mass task
run_point_mass_step: run a simulation step on the PointMass environment given a state and action array
reset_point_mass_env: reset the PointMass environment with a JAX random number generator to initialize a new episode
get_point_mass_obs: get the observation from the PointMass environment by concatenating qpos and qvel
calculate_point_mass_reward: calculate the reward for the PointMass environment based on distance to target and control magnitude
